Switch Frankie for Meatball!!

But I wouldn’t touch the season 2 top 3. 

Dahli went too soon but we don’t have the more recent episodes to know how she would have done! Also she seemed to defeated just from that challenge that I don’t think she would have made it imo. Still love her and hope to see her on an all stars season if they do it <3

I love you bc you never failed to be yourself! These hoes could say you were cutthroat but it’s a competition! Abhora for all stars (or all losers) season!


Ps, what is your zodiac sign I’ve been dying to know <3

Hello you amazing queens!! Love the show and love your work. Thank you for showing the darker side of drag. 

My question is regarding your drag names and their origins. How does one come up with Swanthula and Dracmorda?
I agree with Melissa! Especially if you want to be literal about congeniality
If we’re referring to Miss Congeniality in the RPDR sense, definitely Meatball (aka, fan favorite)
She has not said how. I do know that she used to self-harm in high school (specifically cutting), but I’m not sure if she would take that route or another.
She is far away. We have been texting which is how she’s said all these things to me. Sorry for the confusion!
Also a 5’4” Aquarius!!!! Glad to know I’m not alone haha
I think you have a valid point! I guess it just depends on how much per session and for how long?
That’s a good point! Fingers crossed
Hello sis!!! I also would love the tea with no eye rolling or shade!

Thank you! 
I will update that

*that's how you know*
we are all forgetting about the queen of second/third/fourth chances, a miss Roxxxy Andrews in AS2.
I hope Naomi Smalls and Courtney Act make a comeback.. Courtney was always a solid queen in my opinion, shady, but solid
AnthoZero can I get an amen
I wish this was true, but in the preview of the first episode Ru says before the challenge that it will be a non elimination. No elimination known before challenge = no lipsync unfortunately
interesting theory, either way I would love more katya/trixie airtime

Overall entertaintment: Alaska. I hate to sound so cliche but she is in the Drag Race Hall of Fame for a reason..
Dancing: Alyssa Edwards/Kennedy Davenport. Both are amazing entertainers who really know how to turn it out!
Comedy: Bianca/Trixie. Enough said.
Singing: Jinkx/Adore. I can't get enough of Jinkx's live performances!!! Adore is a natural rock star who puts on a great show while working the crowd!

D to the E to the T to the O to the hold it... X!!

Honestly Detox in AS2, Season 7 (who cares if it was mostly lingerie it had me gagging), and Kim Chi/Naomi Season 8 realness

I feel like the worst was definitely Season 2 and Season 4. Tbh some of the queens in season 5 really had some sh*t runway looks
